caption: The drawing depicts a quilt design composed of multiple stylized flowers and leaves set against a light, off-white, quilted background with diagonal and grid stitching patterns. The main flowers have concentric wavy-edged rings of red and pink with a central yellow circle, and are accompanied by dark green stems and leaves with small yellowish specks; the leaves are generally oval and the stems curve in an undulating, vine-like fashion across the quilt. The composition features one large central flower motif surrounded by sets of smaller, similarly shaped flowers, mostly aligned along the borders, with their vines and leaves interweaving and occupying much of the quilt’s space. There are also small red triangles accenting some leaf clusters, creating a pattern repetition, and the background appears textured with faint stitched floral patterns in addition to the clear grid. The predominant colors are shades of red, pink, yellow, green, and off-white.
title: Sections of Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
